notes: Asking rents, not signed leases. Every Property Finder rental listing in Qatar (33,570 on 14 Oct 2026), grouped by area and unit type; min/max are the 10th and 90th percentiles. Apartments include penthouses, duplexes and hotel apartments; villas include townhouses and compound villas. Groups with fewer than 3 listings are left out.
